Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrReserveInfo

java.lang.Object
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrReserveInfo
public class ZephyrReserveInfo extends Object
The reserve info of the Zephyr network at the current height, as the core's get_reserve_info reports it. Amounts are in atomic units and arrive from the native bridge as decimal strings (the core computes them as 128-bit integers); the two ratios are dimensionless and keep the full double precision of the core. The JSON keys are snake_case, exactly as the bridge emits them.
